name: Demo Fix -> Verify Loop
description: Safe sandboxed demo showing red check -> fix with confirmation -> automatic re-check turning green.

check.name: Temp marker flag present
check.description: Checks for a harmless marker file inside your OS temp directory

fix.name: Create temp marker flag
fix.description: Creates the harmless marker file so check turns green automatically

reset-demo.name: Remove temp marker flag
reset-demo.description: Deletes the marker file to reset the demo back to red
